featured.title: Claude · Anthropic 官方账号
featured.summaryEn: Anthropic shipped a batch of work-oriented updates to Claude. Claude Data (formerly Dashboards) is now generally available on paid plans: beyond dashboards, Claude can draft data stories and narrated videos from your metrics for you to review before sharing, with certified queries and live sharing in beta. New interactive connectors let you open the full version of tools like Adobe, Atlassian and Box inside Claude, editing yourself or with Claude alongside the conversation — rolling out on web and desktop. Claude…
featured.insightZh: Anthropic 今天给 Claude 推了一批面向工作场景的更新。Claude Data（原名 Dashboards）在付费套餐全面可用：除了仪表盘，Claude 还能基于你的指标起草"数据故事"和带旁白的视频，你审阅后再分享；认证查询（certified queries）和实时共享处于 beta。另一个是"交互式连接器"：可以在 Claude 里直接打开 Adobe、Atlassian、Box 等工具的完整版本，在对话旁边自己改，或者让 Claude 和你一起改，先在网页端和桌面端上线。同期还有 Claude Whiteboards、Sheets，都在逐步放量中。

featured.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
featured.summaryEn: Google dropped Gemini 4 Carbon, and Every ran a day-zero vibe check. It's a much better coder than Argon — 44% vs 21% on one run of their Senior Engineer benchmark, though still mid-pack — and can work for hours on ambitious projects, but doesn't always know when to stop: given a backlog, it flagged 6 tasks as ready, then did 15 (including someone else's work) before being stopped after ~4.5 hours. Highlights: a browser-based model of their podcast studio from 3D scans, ~95% of a big update to their internal Every…
featured.insightZh: Google 发布 Gemini 4 Carbon，Every 团队给了第一天的 vibe check：编程明显强于 Argon——内部 Senior Engineer 基准一次跑分 Carbon 44% vs Argon 21%，但仍属中游；能连续干几个小时大项目，但"不太知道什么时候该停"——给它一份 backlog，它认定 6 个任务就绪，结果做了 15 个（包括别人正在做的），跑了近 4.5 小时才被叫停。亮点包括：基于演播室 3D 扫描做出可判断新设备是否入镜的浏览器模型、写了内部视频剪辑器 Everycut 约 95% 的大更新、测试和文档质量高、音视频问题能抓到其他模型漏掉的；短板是容易写出超大文件（Fable 更模块化），界面设计团队意见分裂。写作上与 Argon 基本持平但更贵，Dan 的结论是 🟨"偶尔会用"：给它一个有明确终点的大任务并审核产出，或拿来做第二意见，尤其是音视频。

featured.title: Designing for Agents — Zeno Rocha, Resend
featured.summaryEn: Resend broke into an incumbent-dominated industry with developer experience and agent-friendliness — MCP usage doubling monthly and Claude Code recommending it 60%+ of the time show that in the AI era, distribution has shifted from search engines to the models themselves. Resend, an email infrastructure company, now serves 4.3M users and 120K paying customers (including Warner Bros and HBO), with SDK NPM downloads more than double SendGrid's. Founder Zeno Rocha, a front-end dev and creator of the Dracula theme with no email background, used that naivety to challenge industry norms: no manual signup review, trust by default, but block fast and talk to the user when bounce or complaint rates spike — most cases turn out to be misuse, not abuse. Deliverability is everything: engagement-ordered queues, spaced batches, managed IP pools — essentially "reverse engineer how phishing works and do…
featured.insightZh: Resend 用"开发者体验 + 对 agent 友好"切入一个被巨头把持的老行业——MCP 调用量逐月翻倍、Claude Code 推荐率超 60%，证明在 AI 时代，分发渠道已经从搜索引擎转向了模型本身。 Resend 是一家邮件发送基础设施公司，目前服务 430 万用户、12 万付费客户（含华纳兄弟、HBO），SDK 的 NPM 下载量已超过 SendGrid 一倍以上。创始人 Zeno Rocha 原是前端开发者（Dracula 主题作者），毫无邮件背景，正是这种"天真"让他重新审视行业惯例：去掉注册时的人工审核、默认信任用户，但一旦退信率、投诉率异常就迅速封禁并沟通——多数情况是误用而非滥用。邮件的核心是送达率：要按参与度排队、分批发送、管理 IP 池，本质是"反向工程钓鱼者的行为，做完全相反的事"。他们自动生成纯文本版本以提升送达率，并且正在从 AWS SES 之上的薄层"下沉到底层"，自建 IP 与发送基础设施，发送路径已从 Node.js 改用 Go。 AI 部分最有启发。MCP 调用量每月至少翻倍，8 月底约 120 万次；MCP 工具从约 20 个扩到 80 多个（与 Cloudflare 只给 search/execute 两个工具的思路相反），目标是覆盖 dashboard 100% 的能力。Zeno 作为买家也会因为"有没有官方维护的 MCP"决定选 PostHog 而弃用 Plausible。在 AEO（答案引擎优化）上，他们的做法是：每页加 FAQ、为文档和营销站提供 llms.txt 与.md 版本；一次让模型比较各家价格时，模型把 Resend 说得很离谱，原因是 agent 不执行 JavaScript 价格计算器——把数据写进.md 后几天内模型就答对了。他还观察到 Opus 4.5 时代模型对新工具存在"新近性偏好"，因此要让更多人在更多地方谈论产品。swyx 则分享了自己用"CMO agent"驱动实验、接入 Ahrefs 与自建 AEO 追踪器的"自动研究闭环"。 最后谈到创业与家庭：Zeno 在 YC W23 时女儿一岁…

items.title: Josh Woodward · Google Labs / Gemini App VP
items.summaryEn: Google VP Josh Woodward confirmed Gemini 4 Carbon is live in the Gemini App for Ultra subscribers worldwide.
items.insightZh: Google VP Josh Woodward 确认：Gemini 4 Carbon 已在 Gemini App 上线，面向全球 Ultra 订阅用户开放。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Levie made two points worth noting for enterprise leaders. First, agent swarms could drive another leap in AI output: from chat (fast but rate-limited by human interaction), to agents completing whole tasks, to goal-seeking swarms that find any route to finishing a project. Anywhere value is created in a self-contained digital environment — games, coding, trading, life sciences, IT automation, cyber, math, animation — swarms will win, clearly separating teams that adopt the pattern from those that don't, and creat…
items.insightZh: Levie 发了两条值得企业 IT 决策者关注的观点。一是"Agent 集群（swarms）"会带来 AI 产出的又一次跃迁：从 chat（快速应答但受人交互速率限制）→ agent（独立完成整项任务）→ 目标驱动、会自己找路径完成项目的 agent 集群；凡是价值能在自包含数字环境中产生的领域——游戏开发、编程、交易、生命科学研究、IT 自动化、安全、数学、动画——集群都会最快，采纳与否会把团队明显拉开差距，并会催生一整个新的 FDE（前置部署工程师）工作领域。二是 Box 与 Anthropic 合作，通过 MCP 让 Claude 对 Box 内容具备完整读写能力：agent 不只能调取文件，还能把合同、演示文稿、战略文档的修改直接写回 Box 并在 Claude 内查看。他判断 agent 处理企业文件的频率将是人类的 100 倍。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Less than a week after launch, Vercel Security Review has identified 57,897 vulnerabilities, 6,029 of them critical or high, with 14,665 already patched by the agent. Rauch says he's shocked by both how many critical issues would have gone unnoticed and how easily the agent fixes them; it works on any repo regardless of where you deploy. Separately, he argued that while Rust is superb given it predates agentic coding, agents will let new languages blossom — including purpose-built ones — alongside discretionary C,…
items.insightZh: Vercel Security Review 上线不到一周的数据：识别 57,897 个漏洞，其中 6,029 个为严重或高危，14,665 个已由 Agent 自动修复。Rauch 说他震惊于两点：大量严重漏洞原本会被忽视；以及 agent 自动修复的轻松程度。该功能可用于任何仓库，不论部署在哪里。另一条他谈语言：Rust 在前 agent 时代就已很出色，但有了 agent，新语言（包括为特定用途专门设计的）、按需使用的 C 甚至 LLVM IR、汇编都会兴起——"AI 是流动的，不再一刀切"。

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw 作者、OpenAI
items.summaryEn: Steinberger shared a report: a company ran diagnostics on about 700 systems, found 10,500 vulnerabilities, held an emergency press conference on June 16 and spent three months patching — then re-ran diagnostics with OpenAI's latest model GPT-6 Astra and confirmed 35,000 new ones. "Honestly, we're completely exhausted." Read alongside Rauch's numbers, AI-driven vulnerability discovery is outpacing enterprises' capacity to remediate.
items.insightZh: Steinberger 转引了一则报道：某公司对约 700 套系统做诊断，发现 10,500 个漏洞，6 月 16 日开紧急发布会并花三个月修复；但随后用 OpenAI 最新模型 GPT-6 Astra 重新诊断，又确认了 35,000 个新漏洞——当事人说"说实话，我们已经彻底精疲力尽"。与 Rauch 的数据放在一起看，AI 驱动的漏洞发现正在远超企业的修复能力。

items.title: Thariq · 前 Anthropic Claude Code
items.summaryEn: Former Claude Code team member Thariq argues we need fewer one-shot demos and more tools that show how you can collaborate with models to bring your vision to life.
items.insightZh: 前 Claude Code 团队成员 Thariq 认为：我们需要更少的"一次生成"式炫技 demo，更多能展示如何与模型协作、把自己的构想落地的工具。

items.title: Ryo Lu · Cursor 设计负责人（前 Notion、Stripe）
items.summaryEn: Ryo Lu struck a similar note: the magic happens when humans work together, not when each of us runs our own army of agents in silos. He added that we build software not just to optimize, complete tasks or impose constraints, but to build a world that lets people in, lets them aspire to things they couldn't do before, create, and find themselves — like filmmakers and musicians.
items.insightZh: Ryo Lu 表达了与 Thariq 相近的立场：魔法发生在人与人的协作中，而不是每个人在各自孤岛里指挥一支 agent 大军。他还说，我们做软件不只是为了优化、完成任务或施加约束，而是为了构建一个让人进来、去追求以前做不到的事、去创造并找到自我的世界——就像电影人和音乐人那样。

items.title: Peter Yang · Roblox 产品负责人、AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: Peter Yang made two points: game developers and gamers hating on tasteful use of AI is idiotic — there's a huge difference between pumping out slop and using AI as another tool to make a great game. And while he doesn't care about the stock price, if Anthropic can accelerate cures for terrible diseases it will be one of the most impactful companies in history; he's glad Dario is focused on that rather than viral shorts and TikTok memes.
items.insightZh: Peter Yang 两个观点：一是游戏开发者和玩家无差别抵制"有品位地使用 AI"很愚蠢——用 AI 批量产出垃圾与把 AI 当作做出好游戏的又一工具有本质区别；二是他不关心股价，但如果 Anthropic 能加速攻克那些可怕的疾病，它将成为史上影响最大的公司之一，他很高兴 Dario 专注于此，而不是去争病毒短视频和 TikTok 梗。

items.title: Nan Yu · OpenAI Codex 产品（前 Linear 产品负责人）
items.summaryEn: Nan Yu highlighted a detail in his team's new dictation feature that few dictation apps get right: you can map Apple's dictation key (a special F5 variant), with push-to-talk, double-tap and single-tap shortcuts also supported — crediting @bamitsmanas for getting the edge cases right.
items.insightZh: Nan Yu 点赞了团队新上线的听写（dictation）功能里一个少有产品做对的细节：可以映射 Apple 的听写键（F5 的特殊变体），同时支持按住说话、双击和单击快捷键，并感谢 @bamitsmanas 把边界情况都处理好了。

items.title: Swyx · Latent Space / AI Engineer
items.summaryEn: Swyx teased the AI Engineer livestream (tomorrow and Thursday, 9am-6pm), saying he previewed a keynote under embargo and "you guys don't know what you're in for." He also asked Resend CEO Zeno Rocha why his agents keep choosing Resend — the full conversation is in the Podcasts section below.
items.insightZh: Swyx 预告 AI Engineer 大会直播（明天及周四 9am-6pm），称提前看过某场主题演讲、为此签了保密协议，"你们不知道周四会看到什么"。他还就"为什么我的 agent 总选 Resend"采访了 Resend CEO Zeno Rocha——完整对话见下方 Podcast 板块。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder
items.summaryEn: Two growth notes from Zara: if users don't come back, 20% of the time it's because they don't like your product and 80% of the time they forgot it exists. And step one of building an audience: don't wait until it's done or perfect — share work in progress; sometimes that's how you find out if it's worth finishing.
items.insightZh: Zara 两条产品/增长心得：用户不回来，20% 是因为不喜欢你的产品，80% 是因为忘了你的产品存在；以及建立受众的第一步——别等做完或完美再分享，分享进行中的作品，有时这正是判断它是否值得做完的方式。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: Nikunj recommended Railway's post-mortem as a must-read for every infra provider, quoting MLK on how character shows in times of challenge and praising the team's transparency.
items.insightZh: Nikunj 推荐了 Railway 团队的一份故障复盘（post-mortem），称这是每个基础设施提供商的必读材料，并引用马丁·路德·金的话赞扬其在挑战与争议时刻保持透明。
